description: Infrastructure mode definitions for EVPN MAC Mobility test suite (SW-204115). Determines which tests are valid based on the DUT's EVPN configuration and lab topology.

detection.command: show config network-services evpn instance {evpn_name} | flatten | include seamless-integration

sticky_modes.reason: SC03/SC04/SC06 require PW data-plane MAC learning

spirent_capabilities.reason: PW is BNI; Spirent cannot inject MPLS-tunneled L2 frames into a PW anyway

spirent_vpls_cp.label: Spirent VPLS BGP Peer (non-SI instance, PW active)
spirent_vpls_cp.description: Create a second EVPN instance WITHOUT seamless-integration on PE-1. Spirent establishes l2vpn-vpls BGP peering. PW comes up with active data plane (not BNI). Spirent sends MPLS-labeled L2 frames via vpls-stream using the PW ingress label. PE-1 processes MPLS, pops label, learns source MAC from inner L2 frame.

detection.method: Check for non-SI EVPN instance + Spirent VPLS BGP peer
commands: show config network-services evpn instance {pw_test_evpn_name} | flatten | include seamless-integration
show bgp l2vpn vpls summary | no-more

setup_steps: 1. Ensure VPLS label block allocated: show mpls label-allocation tables | no-more (look for bgp-vpls row != 0). If missing: routing-options bgp-vpls-label-block-size 130
2. Enable BGP l2vpn-vpls AF on PE-1 (UNVALIDATED: verify 'show config protocols bgp {asn} | flatten | include l2vpn-vpls' returns data before assuming syntax)
3. Create non-SI EVPN instance (e.g., PW_TEST_ELAN) with AC on DNAAS path
5. Verify PW up: show evpn vpls-pw | no-more (grep/filter for PW_TEST_ELAN; state != BNI)
6. Get ingress label: show evpn vpls-pw | no-more (grep/filter for PW_TEST_ELAN row)

vpls_label_pool.expect: bgp-vpls row with non-zero label count
vpls_label_pool.alt_check: show config routing-options | flatten | include bgp-vpls-label-block-size
vpls_label_pool.known_bug: SW-253359: on cluster devices, label pool may show 0 labels even after config+restart due to FIB preservation. See known-dnos-bugs.mdc.

validated_show_commands.show mpls label-allocation shared-pool |: PE-1 2026-04-02 -- shows shared pool ranges + per-protocol counts (ldp, rsvp, bgp, sr). No bgp-vpls row here.
validated_show_commands.show mpls label-allocation tables | no-m: SW-253359 evidence -- shows all label tables including bgp-vpls block if configured

bgp_l2vpn_vpls_af.check_command: show config protocols bgp {asn} | flatten | include l2vpn-vpls
bgp_l2vpn_vpls_af.validation_note: VALIDATED on PE-1 2026-04-02: command works, returns expected output

non_si_evpn_instance.check_command: show config network-services evpn instance {pw_test_evpn_name} | no-more

spirent_vpls_peer.check_command: show bgp l2vpn vpls summary | no-more
spirent_vpls_peer.validation_note: VALIDATED on PE-1 2026-04-02: command works, returns expected output

pw_test_evpn_name.description: Non-SI EVPN instance for PW testing

vpls_ve_id.description: Spirent VE-ID (must be >= 1; PE-1 local site-id must be within label block range)

pe1_site_id.description: PE-1 local site-id (MUST be within Spirent label block range: offset 1, block 8 = VE-IDs 1-8)

vpls_peer_loopback.description: Spirent loopback (ISIS/LDP advertised, used as BGP nexthop)

session_discoveries: STC ISIS: NetworkType='P2P' not 'POINT_TO_POINT'; Area1= not AreaId=; hex format '490001' not '49.0001'
STC LDP: No RouterId attribute; use DutIp + TransportTlvMode='TLTV_ADDR'
STC VPLS: --vpls-nexthop forces BGP nexthop to loopback (required for LDP label resolution)
DNOS: update-source REQUIRED even for directly connected iBGP neighbors
DNOS: site-id N site-interface IF is ONE-LINER (site-interface is arg, not subcommand)
DNOS: show evpn vpls-pw has NO instance filter; parse programmatically
DNOS: VE-ID must fall within remote peer label block range (offset+block_size)
dnos_session.py: | no-more breaks config commands; _CFG_PREFIXES detection added

spirent_vpls_cp_dual.label: Spirent VPLS Dual Peer (PW <-> PW data plane)
spirent_vpls_cp_dual.description: Same SI EVPN instance + ISIS+LDP+BGP transport as spirent_vpls_cp, but with TWO Spirent VPLS BGP peers (different VE-IDs and source IPs on the same Spirent port). The DUT sees two distinct PWs against the SI instance and can resolve PW-to-PW MAC moves. Requires the EVI's VPLS label block to cover both VE-IDs (block-size + offset).

detection.method: Two distinct VPLS PWs Installed against the same EVI

notes: Single ISIS+LDP+BGP chain shared between both peers (STC port-level).
Each PW gets its own ingress label -- recipes resolve them as pw1_ingress_label and pw2_ingress_label.
PW-to-PW move: send same inner-src-mac on PW1 label, then PW2 label.

dual_pe_mode.label: Dual-PE Topology

detection.method: Check if a second PE has VPLS PW to the DUT
commands: show bgp l2vpn vpls summary | no-more

dual_pe_mode.setup: Requires second PE (PE-4) with VPLS peering and DNAAS path from Spirent
dual_pe_mode.spirent_role: Send L2 traffic to PE-2 AC via DNAAS. PE-2 forwards over PW to PE-1. PE-1 learns MAC from PW.
dual_pe_mode.dnaas_requirement: Bridge domain from Spirent leaf (B-14) to PE-2's leaf

pw_mac_learning_facts.from_jira_SW191136: The source MAC received on packets from VPLS PW must be learnt and aged out.
pw_mac_learning_facts.mechanism: DATA PLANE. DUT inspects L2 frames arriving on PW, extracts source MAC, adds to MAC table.
pw_mac_learning_facts.not_control_plane: EVPN RT-2 is control plane signaling. PW MAC learning is fundamentally different -- it requires actual traffic on the PW tunnel.
pw_mac_learning_facts.bni_impact: When PW is BNI (Best but Not Installed), no traffic flows on the PW. Therefore no MAC learning from PW is possible.
pw_mac_learning_facts.common_mistake: Replacing PW triggers with EVPN RT-2 injection tests a DIFFERENT functionality (control-plane MAC mobility, not data-plane PW MAC learning).

mh_dnaas_workaround.approach: Spirent port on B-14 sends L2 traffic through two different DNAAS BD paths to two different PEs. Both PEs have same ESI on their ACs.
requirements: Two PEs (e.g., PE-1 and PE-4) with EVPN instances sharing the same ESI
DNAAS BD from B-14 to PE-1's leaf (D-16) -- already exists
DNAAS BD from B-14 to PE-4's leaf -- needs creation
VPLS peering between PE-1 and PE-4

control_plane_alternative.description: Spirent BGP injects EVPN RT-1 (per-EVI/per-ES) and RT-4 (ES route) to simulate a remote PE in the same Ethernet Segment
